hypothesis: A single checkpoint can join public hypothesis tournaments, verified replay, paired-view invariant prediction, local structural repair, challenging synthetic worlds and two-stage consequence planning. Paired closed-loop development performance is evaluated separately from engineering.
scaling_scope: One 2-step binary action environment family suite. One episode ledger added to the existing full native cumulative checkpoint. No parallel accepted learners, architectural replacement, tasks, external source actors, original actions or protected experiments. Appending the synthetic component does not reuse synthetic facts as original causal evidence.
permissions: One selected action from each of two public action choices per stage, with actual synthetic trajectory feedback. Same exogenous episode draws for active and random at identical train index. Fitting receives paired initial views plus revealed x1,s2,x2,y only. Source family, regime, noise and counterfactual outcome are not learner features. Legacy DTR/public weights, historical slots and fault quarantine stay in the complete checkpoint. No held learning. Delayed reward is terminal only.
paired_representation: Select a one-bit public projection using agreement over the first eight paired initial observations, pooled fallback while evidence is unresolved. Measure held cross-view prediction equality and held Brier. This is a paired predictive projection in discrete native state, a bounded JEPA-inspired analogue rather than a trained neural JEPA encoder.
hypothesis_tournament: Full-context vs action-only transition and dependence vs independence on first action for terminal reward. Select using cumulative prequential Brier error over actual observed labels. Explore by disagreement between forecasts, then uncertainty and evidence coverage, tie action0. Explicit native second-stage policy and exact two-step composition reuse the CKAD19 plan structure. Active acquisition uses disagreement for three episodes then executes the current model's composed first and contingent second action on every fourth episode. Both strategies acquire actual revealed consequences.
consolidation_and_repair: Consolidation verifies a complete deduplicated witness replay, with cold persisted state equality at stages. Existing PublicCausalCells sufficient statistics hold the derived weights. When a supported full cell has at least twelve observations and at least .8 majority, three consecutive against its frozen majority may locally reprogram that cell. Record the repair decision and keep all old evidence; unrelated cells/legacy state are preserved. Measure shift recovery and prior regime forgetting, including repair-OFF.
controls: Matched uniformly random exploration with the same observed feedback and full native model
Matched active receipts with structural repair disabled
Same retained evidence with native full-structure projection ablation (force conditional transition and terminal)
Same acquired state with planning disabled at the first decision (fixed0 and fitted terminal action)
Conventional exact fully trained Beta full-history with paired public projection, same active observations
Conventional fully trained MLE on a fixed trailing64 observations with the same public projection and active receipts
Untrained fallback at stage0, preserve independent conventional controls with no held adaptation
metrics: Policy terminal reward by executed synthetic closed-loop trajectories, Brier per transition and terminal on fixed held random actions, view discordance, intervention counts, pre/post-shift reward and error, legacy retention, snapshot parity, wall/CPU/checkpoint bytes. Replay equality tests engineering consistency and alone cannot establish a gain. Independent paired controls and full final regression for engineering. On every model state, both observed views share the same revealed action targets in the evaluation, and independence checks report the projection's actual agreement. No architecture-level neural JEPA claim.

success.engineering: Scopes, exact source and receipts, original action count zero, retained old model bytes and complete cold state round-trip, deterministic Linux/Windows result, full regression and audit. Preserve failed scientific/development gates.
success.development: At the final shifted-family evaluation across three seeds, combined native reward >= .02 above each trained comparator and pooled Brier >= .01 lower than each trained comparator with a predictive readout. Final prior invariant-family reward no more than .05 below the active phase1 reward (after first training stage). Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Evaluate held terminal_switch separately as descriptive zero-shot transfer. Scientific pass remains false.

authority: Existing draft PR1207. Aggregate is engineering/development. Keep all prior negatives. No merge, promotion, deployment, source owner change or interruption of independent studies.
